front_depth_derivation.mechanism: ambient bath T_loc(z) = T0(1+z); the front sits where the ambient field crosses the density-dependent Saha ionization temperature
front_depth_derivation.statement: z_front = T_ion(n)/T0 - 1 ~ 10^3 at absorber-to-diffuse front densities — the edge position is derived from the ambient temperature map, not imposed.

A_column_bookkeeping.statement: The eternal path element per unit redshift exceeds the FLRW c/H element by J(z) ~ 4e7 at z ~ 1080; pointwise equivalence of the two computations would require the eternal electron density to be the FLRW-reconstructed density divided by J — i.e. the eternal surface sits at absorber/diffuse densities rather than cosmic-recombination densities.  The descriptions are therefore not the same computation pointwise; they are the same integrated column under different density x path conventions.  Which convention is physical is the eternal model itself: the eternal path law is the corpus's derived geometry (Step 07), so the TH Peebles kernel is read as the FLRW reconstruction of the same observable column, not as the physical profile.

B_diffusion.convention: matter-frame angular distance D_A = chi/(1+z); matter-frame diffusion sigma_D^2 = sum lambda_mfp^2 dN over scattering zones
B_diffusion.note: Zones are integrated separately; the front column (the concentrated-column parametrization of the ionization edge, 'wall' zone) is the only region with N_scatter ~ 1, so it carries the diffusion blur (sigma_D ~ mfp_front ~ 3.9e3 Mpc matter-frame). The wing/trough contribute N_scatter << 1 — their positional spread is the g(z) tail of Part C, not diffusion.  The post-edge zone is absorptive (kappa_abs >> 11/L0, Step 18C): photons are destroyed there rather than Thomson-scattered onward, so it enters the budget through suppression of the tail, not through the diffusion integral.  Under the eternal D_A the implied damping multipole lands in the observed Silk range — upgrading the Step-16B geometric estimate (ell ~ 1241) with the explicit scattering-count integral.  This is a diffusion scale, not the full acoustic spectrum.

C_kernel_comparison.note: The kernels agree on the integrated column (tau = 1 at z ~ 1080-1085, wing tau ~ 0.054) and differ in morphology: the mapped-FLRW kernel is a broad Saha sweep (FWHM ~ 10^2 in z), the eternal profile is a sharp ionization front — the Stroemgren edge between the neutral foreground and the deep plasma zone, parametrized here as a concentrated column (FWHM ~ 3e-5 in z) — plus diffuse wings.  The width difference is the physical content of the eternal model — the 'recombination front' is a spatial ionization boundary, not a freeze-out sweep — and its angular signature is governed by the diffusion scale of Part B, not the z-width.

verdict: Reconciliation at the level of the integrated column: the eternal profile and the mapped-FLRW (TEP-TH) computation agree on tau = 1 at z ~ 1080 and tau_reion ~ 0.054 — the same observable surface under two bookkeepings.  The physical difference is morphological: the eternal surface is a spatial ionization front — the Stroemgren edge of the deep plasma zone, parametrized as a concentrated column plus diffuse wings — while the mapped-FLRW surface is a temporal plasma freeze-out (broad bump).  The eternal model posits no wall, no density shell, and no recombination era: the front is a phase boundary in the ambient radiation field, sharp because the LyC-absorption length at the edge is short (Step 18A).  Its depth is derived rather than imposed: the ambient bath T_loc(z) = T0(1+z) crosses the Saha ionization temperature at z_front = T_ion/T0 - 1 ~ 917-1057 across the diffuse-to-absorber front-density range, bracketing the observed boundary depth.  The eternal-model damping scale is now computed rather than estimated: the random-walk integral over the scattering zones gives sigma_D ~ mfp of the front column ~ 3.9e3 Mpc (matter frame), subtending theta_D ~ 8.05e-04 rad vs the observed Silk angle ~6.50e-04 rad (ratio ~1.24; equivalently an FLRW-comoving diffusion length ~11 Mpc vs the observed ~9 Mpc, i.e. the diffusion-convention multipole ell_D ~ 1242 vs the observed ~1400-1600).  The eternal front's single-scattering-depth blur therefore lands essentially on the observed Silk scale — upgrading the Step-16B geometric estimate (ell ~ 1241) to the explicit diffusion integral, with residual freedom in kappa_abs, front column density and the approach profile absorbing the ~25% offset.  The residual item that would discriminate the morphologies is the native perturbation mode spectrum: the eternal model supplies the surface and its diffusion scale, while the acoustic peak structure requires the boundary's own baryon-photon perturbation transfer — the computation flagged as the open item in this sector.
